en.headline: CHP records two more severe paediatric flu cases; school outbreaks rise
en.dek: An 11-year-old boy and a six-year-old boy remain in serious condition with influenza A complications; the centre said school outbreaks have climbed to 73 cases involving 398 people since the new term began.
body: The Centre for Health Protection recorded two additional severe paediatric influenza cases on Thursday, bringing the cumulative total since late June to 19.

The first involves an 11-year-old boy with previously good health who developed fever, cough and drowsiness on Wednesday and was later admitted to a paediatric intensive care unit with influenza A complicated by septic shock and encephalitis. The second concerns a six-year-old boy with underlying illnesses who has influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia.

Both boys had not received seasonal influenza vaccine in the previous season. The centre noted that school influenza-like illness outbreaks have risen sharply since the start of the school year, with 73 outbreaks involving 398 people recorded by Wednesday, and urged the public to get vaccinated when the 2026/27 programme begins on 17 September.

zh.headline: 衞防中心錄兩宗兒童流感嚴重個案 學校爆發升至73宗
zh.dek: 11歲及6歲男童分別因甲型流感併發敗血性休克及腦炎、嚴重肺炎留醫深切治療部，情況嚴重；中心指開學後學校流感樣疾病爆發已達73宗，涉及398人。
body: 衞生防護中心周四公布新增兩宗兒童感染流感嚴重個案，本流感季節由6月底至今累計已有19宗。
首宗個案為一名過往健康良好的11歲男童，周三出現發燒、咳嗽和嗜睡，其後入住兒童深切治療部，診斷為甲型流感併發敗血性休克及腦炎。第二宗為一名有長期病患的6歲男童，診斷為甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎，兩人目前情況嚴重。
兩名男童上年度均未接種季節性流感疫苗。中心指9月開學後學校爆發個案大幅上升，截至周三共有73宗、涉及398人，並呼籲市民在9月17日展開的2026/27年度接種計劃開始後盡快接種。
